mapper.select: select count(h.id) as num,t.name from hidden_danger_new h left join hidden_danger_type t on h.hidden_type_id = t.id where h.submit_time between #{period.begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{param1.end,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} group by h.hidden_type_id order by num desc
SELECT count( h.id ) FROM hidden_danger_new h where h.submit_time between #{period.begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{param1.end,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}

SELECT count( h.id ) AS num, t.NAME AS type_name, hdl.NAME AS level_name, COALESCE ( SUM( IF ( h.state = 'FINISHED', 1, 0 )), 0 ) AS finishNum FROM hidden_danger_new h INNER JOIN hidden_danger_type t ON h.hidden_type_id = t.id INNER JOIN hidden_danger_level hdl ON hdl.id = h.urgency_level where h.submit_time between #{period.begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{param1.end,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} GROUP BY h.hidden_type_id, h.urgency_level

SELECT * FROM hidden_danger_new hdn WHERE hdn.tenant = #{tenant}
and hdn.update_time between #{period.begin} and #{period.end}
SELECT a.* FROM ( SELECT COUNT( id ) num, hidden_obj_id deviceId FROM hidden_danger_new WHERE hidden_obj_type = 'DEVICE' GROUP BY hidden_obj_id ORDER BY submit_time ) a WHERE a.num >=#{num}

SELECT IFNULL(hdcg.NAME,'其他') as `name`, count(1) as `value` FROM hidden_danger_new hd LEFT JOIN hidden_danger_type t on hd.hidden_type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN hidden_danger_category hdcg ON t.hidden_danger_category_id = hdcg.id where hd.submit_time BETWEEN #{period.begin} AND #{period.end} GROUP BY `name` ORDER BY `value` desc
SELECT hd.state as `name`, count(1) as `value` FROM hidden_danger_new hd where hd.submit_time BETWEEN #{period.begin} AND #{period.end} GROUP BY `name`
